courses.title: ToolTest 3 - Move Face with Auto-Heal
courses.objective: Move and rotate selected faces while inspecting extension, trimming or tilting of neighboring faces during healing.

steps.title: Prepare a reference solid
steps.instructions: Create a solid whose selected face has several neighboring faces.
steps.expectedResult: A valid target for face movement.

checkpoint.expected: A valid target for face movement.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Translate the face
steps.instructions: Select the face and translate it by an exact amount.
steps.expectedResult: The face relocates and neighboring faces reconnect.

checkpoint.expected: The face relocates and neighboring faces reconnect.

validationChecks: Move is stored as a Move feature
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Rotate the face
steps.expectedResult: The face changes orientation and the surrounding topology heals.

checkpoint.expected: The face changes orientation and the surrounding topology heals.

validationChecks: Neighboring faces extend, trim or tilt as needed
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Edit the Move feature
steps.instructions: Change translation or rotation and regenerate.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.
